== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|The [[Everwood]] continent is a vast landmass ruled by [[Emriss Silentborn]], the [[Remnant]] [[Monarch]] and [[Queen]] of the continent. A former [[men’hla tree]], [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]] is known for her soothing presence and her historical efforts to advance civilization and make education accessible to all. The continent is home to the [[Silent King]], who resides within its jungles, and [[Emriss Silentborn|Emriss]]'s power and preparations are noted as a primary defense against the [[Silent King]]'s potential dominance. The region is also known for its unique relationship with men’hla trees, which are considered sacred and serve as a vital resource for [[Soulsmiths]] due to their ability to produce [[Remnants]]. [[Traveling]] to the continent is difficult without utilizing [[labyrinth|the labyrinth]], as it is located on the opposite side of the world.}}
